# QuickNova AI Coding Agent Instructions

## Project Overview
QuickNova is a **client-side productivity tools platform** (30+ free online tools) with a glassmorphism UI, dark/light mode, and embedded ad monetization. 100% vanilla JavaScript—no build process or frameworks.

## Architecture Patterns

### 1. **Tool Structure** (Reusable Pattern)
Each tool follows a consistent layout:
- **HTML file**: `tools/{tool-name}.html` (standalone page)
- **JS handler**: `js/tools/{tool-name}.js` (logic, initialized via `DOMContentLoaded`)
- **Shared CSS**: `css/theme.css` (CSS variables), `base.css`, `components.css`, `layout.css`
- **Utilities**: `js/utils.js` provides `copyToClipboard()`, `downloadFile()`, `showToast()`, `simulateLoading()`

**Example pattern** (see `ai-chat.js`):
```javascript
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // 1. Cache DOM elements
    const element = document.getElementById('id');
    // 2. Load state from localStorage
    let state = { /* initial */ };
    loadState(); // from localStorage
    // 3. Setup event listeners
    element.addEventListener('click', handler);
});
```

### 2. **Tools Registry** (`tools-data.js`)
Single source of truth for all tools:
```javascript
const toolsData = [
    { id: 'ai-chat', name: 'AI Chat', category: 'ai', desc: '...', icon: '🤖', 
      link: '/tools/ai-chat.html', keywords: '...' }
    // 30+ more tools
];
```
Used by: home grid rendering, search/filter, trending section, schema generation.
**Update this file when adding tools.**

### 3. **Theme System** (CSS Variables)
`css/theme.css` defines light/dark modes via `data-theme` attribute:
```css
:root {
    --bg: #f8f9fa;
    --bg-elevated: #ffffff;
    --text-main: #1a1a1a;
    --accent-blue: #0070f3;
}
[data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg: #0f172a;
    --accent-blue: #00f3ff;
}
```
**Toggle element**: `.theme-toggle` button (emoji sun/moon). Saved to `localStorage.theme`.

### 4. **State Management** (localStorage Only)
No server backend. All state persisted to localStorage:
- `qn_favorites` → JSON array of favorited tool IDs
- `qn_recent` → Recent tool visits (last 20)
- `qn_streak` → Visitor day streak
- `theme` → User theme preference (light/dark)
- `qn_ad_views` → Ad view counter (sessionStorage)
- Tool-specific: `qn_visits_{pathname}` for nudges

**Important**: Always wrap localStorage calls in try-catch (storage quota errors).

## Core Workflows

### Adding a New Tool
1. **Create HTML**: `tools/{name}.html` — must include `<meta>` tags for SEO (Open Graph, Twitter card)
2. **Create JS**: `js/tools/{name}.js` — export results via `downloadFile()` or `copyToClipboard()`
3. **Add to registry**: Insert entry in `js/tools-data.js` with all fields (id, name, category, desc, icon, link, keywords)
4. **CSS**: Reuse variables from theme.css; add tool-specific `.tool-container` styles inline or in `components.css`
5. **Test**: Verify theme toggle, mobile responsiveness, localStorage access

### Deployment
- **Environment**: Vercel (see `vercel.json` for header caching rules)
- **Domain**: quicknova.vercel.app (production)
- **Sitemap**: Auto-generated by `scripts/generate-sitemap.js` (tracks all tool URLs)
- **PWA**: Service worker at `service-worker.js` for offline support

### Search & Discovery
- **Homepage grid** renders from `toolsData` (see `initToolsGrid()` in main.js)
- **Search**: Real-time client-side filtering on tool name/desc/keywords
- **Filter chips**: Category-based (ai, image, pdf, utility, audio-video)
- **Trending section**: Tools marked with `badges: ['popular', 'new', 'updated']`
- **URL params**: `?q=search` pre-fills search; `?utm_*` params track referral sources

## Ad System (Revenue Model)
Critical monetization layer in `main.js`. Do **NOT** remove ad infrastructure.

- **SmartAds class**: Central ad manager with opt-out tracking (`qn_ads_optout`)
- **Slots**: `.ad-slot` divs with type: BANNER, NATIVE, POPUNDER, SOCIAL, SMARTLINK
- **Load strategy**: INSTANT on page load (not lazy—maximizes impressions)
- **Debug mode**: Add `?ads=debug` to URL to trigger ad debug panel
- **Ad providers**: Effective Gate CPM (native ads, banner ads, popunder)
- **When adding tools**: Ensure `.ad-slot.ad-content` exists in tool-container for in-tool ads

## Common Code Patterns

### Toast Notifications
```javascript
showToast('Success!', 'success'); // or 'error', 'info'
// CSS handles color based on type
```

### File Downloads
```javascript
downloadFile(content, 'filename.txt', 'text/plain');
// Uses Blob + URL.createObjectURL + auto-cleanup
```

### API Calls (Free Inference)
- **AI Chat**: Uses Pollinations.ai `/openai/v1/chat/completions` (no key needed)
- **Image Generation**: Pollinations.ai `/generate` (text-to-image)
- **Speech-to-Text**: Web Speech API (browser native)
- **Text-to-Speech**: Web Speech API
- **Background Removal**: `@xenova/transformers` (ES6 import, client-side ML)

### Error Handling
Wrap all async operations and localStorage in try-catch. Show user-friendly toast errors, log details to console.

## Key Files Reference
- **index.html**: Homepage (30+ tool grid, trending, search)
- **js/main.js**: Core initialization (theme, ads, search, PWA, analytics)
- **js/tools-data.js**: Tool registry (update when adding tools)
- **js/utils.js**: Shared utility functions
- **css/theme.css**: Design tokens (colors, animations, glassmorphism)
- **css/base.css, components.css, layout.css**: Reusable component styles
- **tools/*.html**: Individual tool pages
- **js/tools/*.js**: Tool-specific logic

## Design & UX Principles
- **Glassmorphism**: Blur backgrounds, semi-transparent panels, neon accents
- **Dark mode first**: Default to dark theme with user override
- **Mobile-first**: All tools must work on mobile (responsive grid/flexbox)
- **Accessibility**: Use semantic HTML, ARIA labels on interactive elements
- **Icons as visual language**: Use emoji (🤖, 📄, 🎨) for tool identity
- **Smooth animations**: CSS transitions on interactions (0.3s ease)

## Development Tips
- **No build process**: Edit `.js` and `.css` directly—no transpilation needed
- **Testing**: Use browser DevTools; check console for errors
- **Hot reload**: Many editors support live server; Vercel auto-deploys on git push
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4 (ID: G-88T5VL450S) tracks all events
- **Keyboard shortcuts**: Ctrl+K focuses search, Ctrl+/ toggles sidebar (in tools like AI Chat)

## Important Constraints
- **No external dependencies** (except CDN libs for specific tools: pdf-lib, jspdf, transformers, FFmpeg)
- **Storage quota**: localStorage is shared; verify remaining space before massive saves
- **CORS**: All API calls must use public/free APIs (no sensitive keys in code)
- **Performance**: Keep JS bundles small; prefer native APIs over polyfills
- **Ad resilience**: Always check if ads fail to load gracefully (try-catch around ad injection)
